exposure: Amniotic fluid level change (pre- to post-FETO)
outcome: Survival rate at 6 months of age
Requirement for home oxygen therapy at 6 months of age
cohort: The study included 16 cases of fetuses with severe congenital diaphragmatic hernia whose mothers underwent prenatal treatment by fetoscopic endoluminal tracheal occlusion (FETO) between 2018 and 2021.
finding: The survival rate at 6 months of age for severe CDH cases treated with FETO was 50%, with survivors having earlier balloon insertion, greater amniotic fluid level and O/E LHR changes post-FETO, and later gestational age at delivery compared to non-survivors.
gest_age: Median GA at balloon insertion was 28.4 weeks (IQR 27.8-28.6); median GA at delivery was 37 weeks (IQR 34.4-37.8).
